title: MSFS marketplace warning: Don't buy these new Airliners!
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace releases that represent both the absolute best and the absolute worst of flight simulation addons.

We dive deep into high-fidelity heavy hitters like the Black Square Caravan Professional Bundle to see if this legendary single-engine turboprop delivers the ultimate advanced simulation experience. Packing over 100 possible system failures, 12 hot-swappable radio configurations, and an advanced tablet EFB, it brings a true study-level triumph to the sim. We also take an objective look at Captain Sim's vintage Fokker D7 biplane to see if this World War I classic delivers a rewarding stick-and-rudder throwback experience or if its clean exterior textures miss the mark.

⚠️ CRITICAL MARKETPLACE WARNING: We are waving a massive red flag because a wave of low-effort releases has flooded the storefront—specifically the commercial widebody lines from MScenery, including the A340 and the 757-300 Enhanced Editions. Despite their tempting five-star ratings, external 8K visual modeling, and slick promotional screenshots, the shocking reality behind these system-light asset flips is something every flight simmer needs to hear before clicking buy. We pull back the exterior models to show you exactly why you need to look closer at the missing cockpit details before spending your hard-earned money, while exposing why these fishy storefront reviews mean Microsoft needs to step in.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar!
